method.target: interior zone reachable from party spawn
method.path_ft: Dijkstra over passable cells; 5 ft per step, map cell.moveCost multiplier when present; doors passable as future physical routes; blocking props excluded
method.neighbors: orthogonal four-neighbor grid only; no diagonals
method.alternative_ingress: for each target-zone ingress door, remove that door and retest reachability; count doors whose removal still leaves the target reachable
method.exposed_steps: steps on the canonical minimum movement-cost path with no adjacent wall/edge cover and no prop cover; static proxy only
method.action_economy: 30 ft baseline is a comparison bucket, not a combat outcome; no actor speed, Dash, action, LOS target, spell, or reaction is modeled
